invariants.rationale: Every return of this method is either null or not null, reflecting reference value possibility; included for completeness but is trivial.
When the method returns a non-null result, overIndex must not be -1, so it is at least zero.
If overIndex is not -1, result must not be null (non-null result only possible when overIndex != -1).
When overIndex is not -1, the result is precisely items.get(overIndex).
If the result is non-null, it must be an item from the items list.
